conventions.parameter_weights: held-out class-step exposures per voter; reliability weighted by held-out step-voter exposures
conventions.correlations: all answer steps centered before class/population selection; class means removed by Pearson correlation
conventions.posterior_calibration: uses saved held-out probabilities only; failed model posteriors remain undefined
conventions.bins: ten fixed equal-width [0,1] bins; final bin includes 1
conventions.assumption_limit: Class-conditional correlation is descriptive, not an independence proof; source/answer observations are dependent. No IID standard errors or equivalence claims.
